idea-plugin.name: PCI Payment Page Script Audit
idea-plugin.description:
PCI DSS 4.0.1 requirements 6.4.3 and 11.6.1 have been mandatory since 2025-03-31, and the PCI SSC revised FAQ 1331 on 2026-08-04 so a QSA agreement alone no longer marks them not applicable. This reads a checkout page and names every script that has no authorization method, no integrity method and no inventory row.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → PCI Payment Page Script Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 26 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/pci-payment-page-script-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/pci-payment-page-script-audit
